# ZapGram

> Bitcoin Lightning wallet inside Telegram — send, receive, tip, and monetize chats with sats.

ZapGram is a free Telegram bot that gives every user a Lightning wallet on first open. It supports group and channel tips, BOLT11 invoices with QR, zero-fee transfers between ZapGram wallets, paid private groups and channels (one-time or monthly), and optional Nostr Wallet Connect (NWC) for self-custody.

## Product

- Bot: https://t.me/zap_gram_bot
- Site (EN): https://zapgram.mozharov.me/
- Site (RU): https://zapgram.mozharov.me/ru/
- Source (MIT): https://github.com/mozharov/zapgram

## Who it is for

- Bitcoiners and Lightning users who want sats in Telegram
- Nostriches who prefer NWC / self-custody optional path
- Community owners who sell chat access in sats
- Creators who want tips under posts and in groups

Not for: card-only checkout, enterprise KYC invoicing, multi-asset trading, or fiat rails.

## Fees

- Bot and wallet: free to open and use
- ZapGram → ZapGram transfers: free
- External Lightning: network fees as usual
- Paid-chat owner payouts on the hosted bot: small platform fee (default 5%)

## Key facts

- Category: Telegram Lightning wallet / tip bot / sat-gated community access
- Custody: built-in wallet is custodial convenience; optional NWC for self-custody
- Languages: bot UI Russian + English; marketing site EN (canonical) + RU
- License: MIT open source; self-host available, hosted bot is the primary product
